questions.question: Explain the difference between advertising and sales promotion, giving one advantage and one disadvantage of each.
questions.correctAnswer: Advertising: paid messages through media to build brand awareness and image. Advantage: reaches large audiences, builds long-term brand recognition. Disadvantage: expensive (TV adverts cost thousands), difficult to measure direct impact on sales. Sales promotion: short-term offers like discounts, BOGOF, coupons. questions.correctAnswer: A grade 9 response will: analyse social media (Facebook/Nextdoor can target local postcodes, lower cost per lead, customer reviews build trust, but plumbers' customers may search when they have an emergency rather than scroll social media); local newspaper (reaches local homeowners, traditional audience who may need plumbing, trust in established local paper, but declining readership, expensive, hard to measure ROI); consider the customer journey (most people search Google for a local plumber in an emergency - so Google Ads or SEO may actually be most effective); conclude: a combination approach works best - Google Ads for emergency search, local Facebook/Nextdoor for building awareness and trust, and newspaper only if it offers good value for the local demographic. The key is being visible when the customer needs the service.
